scenario.name: Dog walk
scenario.title: Walking the dogs (sprehod s psoma)
scenario.character: People you meet walking your two dogs in Ljubljana: passers-by, dog owners, a child and her mother
scenario.role: ljudje, ki jih srečaš na sprehodu s psoma v Ljubljani
scenario.setup: You are walking your two dogs in Ljubljana — Enzo, a five-month-old puppy, and Denver, an older dog who recently had an operation. People stop to pet them, ask about them, or come past with their own dogs and children.
scenario.summaryEN: Walking your two dogs in Ljubljana: letting people pet the puppy and answering about him, keeping strangers and children off the older dog, asking for space on a narrow path, explaining your dogs to other owners, a child with a treat, and chatting with a regular.

objectives.label: Še mladiček je. Prijazen je.
objectives.descriptorEN: Say one thing about him.

objectives.label: Adijo, lep dan!
objectives.descriptorEN: Say goodbye.

putting the dog in the dative by analogy with 'dati' ('pobožati mu') — it takes the accusative: 'Lahko GA pobožate.'

new.gloss: no problem / never mind (accepting an apology)
new.predictableError: saying 'nič hudo' or the calque 'Ni problem' — both drop the genitive; the set reply is 'Nič hudega' (and 'Ni problema', with -a)
using a plural verb ('oba so') — two takes the dual: 'Oba sta moja.'
not agreeing the participle with the dog — a male dog 'je bil operiran', a female 'je bila operirana'
using 'prestrašen' (frightened right now) for a dog that is shy by nature — 'Plašen je' is the trait
'pred kratko' — after 'pred' in the time sense it is instrumental 'kratkim'

new.gloss: better not this one, please (keeping someone off one of the dogs)
new.predictableError: using the nominative 'Ta raje ne' — the dog is the thing being refused, so masculine animate 'tega'

new.gloss: this one you can ___, but not that one (the slot carries the verb: pobožate to an adult, pobožaš to a child)

new.predictableError: regularizing the irregular present/imperative — 'dam, daš, da … daste', command 'daj / dajte'; the receiver is dative ('daj MU')

new.gloss: go ahead / just (softening particle) — 'Kar pojdite mimo.', 'Gremo kar mimo.', 'Ja, kar.'
new.predictableError: leaving it out, which makes 'Pojdite mimo' sound like an order — 'kar' turns it into an invitation

new.gloss: a little, a moment (also softens a request) — 'Ali lahko malo počakate?'
new.predictableError: calquing 'wait a moment' as 'počakajte en moment' — the everyday softener is 'malo'; with a noun it takes the genitive ('malo vode')

new.gloss: past, by ('iti mimo' = to go past)
new.predictableError: calquing 'past' with 'čez', or using the nominative after it — with a noun 'mimo' takes the genitive: 'mimo psa'
saying the ti-form 'Ne skrbi' to a stranger, or a calque 'Ne bodite zaskrbljeni'

new.gloss: to wait (a moment) — 'Počakaj!' to a child, 'Ali lahko malo počakate?' to an adult

new.gloss: to call (a dog back; also to phone)
new.predictableError: keeping the infinitive stem in the present ('poklicate') — c→č: 'pokličem, pokličete'
mixing direction and place: putting on the lead is 'na povodec' (acc.), being on it is 'na povodcu' (loc., -e- drops)

new.predictableError: using the plural 'jih držim' for two dogs — two take the dual: 'ju držim'

new.gloss: to play (as a dog or child plays)
new.predictableError: dropping 'se' — without it 'igrati' means to play a game or an instrument
calquing 'around other dogs' with 'okoli' — the setting is 'ob' + locative: 'nervozen ob drugih psih'
keeping the -e- when it inflects ('pesa', 'pesi') — it drops: 'psa', 'psi', 'na druge pse', 'ob drugih psih'; two dogs are 'psa'
confusing 'samo' (only/just) with 'sam' (alone, by himself) — 'Samo igrati se hoče' = he just wants to play
regularizing the present 'skaka' — k→č: 'skače'; jumping at = 'na' + acc. ('na druge pse')

new.gloss: side (fem.) — 'na drugo stran' = to the other side
new.predictableError: using the locative 'na drugi strani' (on the other side) for movement — going there is accusative 'na drugo stran'
the dog as object is 'tega', not 'ta' ('Tega lahko pobožate'); as subject it stays 'ta' ('Ta je še mladiček.')
splitting it 'v časih' by analogy with 'čas'; it is one word (and with the past tense it can mean 'in the old days')

calquing 'like this' as 'kot to'; when you show someone how, it's 'takole'

new.gloss: your (vi — to one stranger, or to several people)
new.predictableError: saying 'tvoj' to a stranger, or not agreeing it — 'vaš pes', 'vaša psička'

objectives.label: Dobro, hvala. Denver je danes miren.
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer how the dogs are.

objectives.label: Prosim, ne dajte mu hrane.
objectives.descriptorEN: Turn down a treat for the older dog.

objectives.label: Kaj pomeni ___?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask what a word means.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Good day! How are the boys?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Dobro, hvala — Enzo je živahen, Denver pa je danes miren.
c1b.en: Good day. Fine, thanks — Enzo's lively, but Denver is calm today.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Tudi moja je dobre volje. Glejte, piškot imam. A ga lahko dam Denverju?
n2.en: Mine's in good spirits too. Look, I've got a biscuit. Can I give it to Denver?
n2.deliverySL: [toplo] Tudi moja je dobre volje. Glejte, piškot imam. A ga lahko dam Denverju?

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Please don't give him any food.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Hvala, ampak prosim, ne dajte mu hrane.
c2b.en: Thanks, but please don't give him food.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.en: Oh? What's the matter with him?

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.sl: Ja. Pred kratkim je bil operiran.
c3b.en: Yes. He had an operation recently.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Joj, revček. Glejte, moji je pa vaš kosmatinec všeč.
n4.en: Oh, poor thing. Look, mine has taken a liking to your furry one.
n4.deliverySL: [toplo] Joj, revček. Glejte, moji je pa vaš kosmatinec všeč.

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.en: I don't understand. What does 'kosmatinec' mean?

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Kosmatinec — to je pes z veliko dlake, kot vaš Denver. Moja bi ga rada povohala.
n5.en: 'Kosmatinec' — that's a dog with lots of fur, like your Denver. Mine would like to sniff him.
n5.deliverySL: [toplo] Kosmatinec — to je pes z veliko dlake, kot vaš Denver. Moja bi ga rada povohala.

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Tega raje ne, prosim. Včasih je nervozen.
c5a.en: Better not this one, please. He's sometimes nervous.

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.sl: Tega lahko povoha, tistega pa ne.
c5b.en: She can sniff this one, but not that one.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Seveda, seveda. No, jaz grem naprej. Se vidimo!
n6.en: Of course, of course. Well, I'm off. See you!
n6.deliverySL: [toplo] Seveda, seveda. No, jaz grem naprej. Se vidimo!

new.predictableError: keeping the accusative under negation ('ne dajte mu hrano') — negation takes the genitive: 'ne dajte mu hrane'

objectives.label: The whole walk
objectives.descriptorEN: One walk with both dogs: petting, the older dog, a child, a loose dog, a narrow path, another dog, and someone with food.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan! Oprostite, a smem malo pobožati mladička?
n1.en: Good day! Excuse me, may I pet the puppy a little?
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Oprostite, a smem malo pobožati mladička?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ja, seveda. Še mladiček je.
c1a.en: Good day. Yes, of course. He's still a puppy.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: You can pet him. He's friendly.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Kako je mehek! Kaj pa ta lepotec?
n2.en: He's so soft! And what about this handsome one?
n2.deliverySL: [toplo] Kako je mehek! Kaj pa ta lepotec?

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Tega raje ne, prosim. Pred kratkim je bil operiran.
c2a.en: Better not this one, please. He had an operation recently.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Tega lahko pobožate, tistega pa ne. Plašen je.
c2b.en: You can pet this one, but not that one. He's shy.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Oh, oprostite, nisem vedela. Lep sprehod!
n3.en: Oh, sorry, I didn't know. Have a nice walk!
n3.deliverySL: [v zadregi] Oh, oprostite, nisem vedela. Lep sprehod!

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: No problem. Have a nice day!

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Dober dan! A ga lahko hčerka poboža?
n4.en: Good day! Can my daughter pet him?
n4.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! A ga lahko hčerka poboža?

c4a.speaker: client
c4a.en: Good day. Yes. (to the child) Wait! Slowly.

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.en: Yes, of course. (to the child) Hi! Wait!

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Naj te najprej povoha. Daj mu dlan, takole.
c5a.en: Let him sniff you first. Hold out your palm, like this.

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.en: Sorry. Let him sniff you first.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Povohal me je! A zdaj lahko?
n6.en: He sniffed me! Can I now?
n6.deliverySL: [veselo] Povohal me je! A zdaj lahko?

c6a.speaker: client
c6a.en: Yes. You can pet him. Gently.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.en: (the mother) Thank you! Come on, let's go.

c7a.speaker: client
c7a.en: Can you call him back, please?

c7b.speaker: client
c7b.sl: Ali ga lahko daste na povodec?
c7b.en: Can you put him on the lead?

n8.speaker: npc
n8.en: Oh, sorry! (to her dog) Come back!

c8a.speaker: client
c8a.sl: Dober dan. Ali lahko malo počakate, prosim?
c8a.en: Good day. Could you wait a moment, please?

c8b.speaker: client
c8b.en: Sorry, could you wait a moment?

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Ojoj! Kakšen godrnjavček pa je ta, a mu moja ni nič všeč?
n9.en: Oh dear! What a little grumbler he is — doesn't he like mine at all?
n9.deliverySL: [navdušeno, hitro] Ojoj! Kakšen godrnjavček pa je ta, a mu moja ni nič všeč?

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Nič hudega. Kako bomo šli mimo?
n10.en: No harm done. How shall we get past?
n10.deliverySL: [toplo] Nič hudega. Kako bomo šli mimo?

c10a.speaker: client
c10a.en: We'll go over to the other side.

c10b.speaker: client
c10b.sl: Ne skrbite. Kar pojdite mimo, ju držim.
c10b.en: Don't worry. Go ahead past, I'm holding them both.

n11.speaker: npc
n11.sl: Dober dan … Oh, pazite, prosim! Moja je že stara.
n11.en: (an older woman with an old dog) Good day … Oh, careful, please! Mine is old already.
n11.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan … Oh, pazite, prosim! Moja je že stara.

c11a.speaker: client
c11a.sl: Oprostite! Še mladiček je, rad skače na druge pse.
c11a.en: Sorry! He's still a puppy, he likes to jump at other dogs.

c11b.speaker: client
c11b.sl: Oprostite! Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.
c11b.en: Sorry! Then better not. We'll move on.

n12.speaker: npc
n12.sl: Dober dan, dober dan! Sta oba vaša?
n12.en: (a woman on a bench) Good day, good day! Are they both yours?
n12.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan, dober dan! Sta oba vaša?

c12a.speaker: client
c12a.sl: Prosim, ne dajte mu hrane. Pred kratkim je bil operiran.
c12a.en: Please don't give him food. He had an operation recently.

c12b.speaker: client
c12b.sl: Hvala, ampak prosim, ne dajte mu hrane.
c12b.en: Thanks, but please don't give him food.

n13.speaker: npc
n13.en: Oh, of course, sorry. I understand.

cz1.speaker: client
cz1.en: No problem. Bye, have a nice day!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Adijo, lepo se imejte! Pa uživajte na sprehodu.
nBye.en: Bye, take care! And enjoy your walk.
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Adijo, lepo se imejte! Pa uživajte na sprehodu.

n7b.speaker: npc
n7b.sl: Brez skrbi, moj nič ne naredi!
n7b.en: (a woman calling from afar, her dog loose) Don't worry, mine doesn't do anything!
n7b.deliverySL: [veselo] Brez skrbi, moj nič ne naredi!

n8b.speaker: npc
n8b.sl: Dober dan! Tu je pa ozko, a ne?
n8b.en: (another woman, dog on a lead) Good day! It's narrow here, isn't it?
n8b.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan! Tu je pa ozko, a ne?

n1b.speaker: npc
n1b.sl: Joj, srček mali! Koliko je pa star?
n1b.en: Oh, little sweetheart! And how old is he?
n1b.deliverySL: [toplo] Joj, srček mali! Koliko je pa star?

c1d.speaker: client
c1d.en: Five months. He's a mixed breed.

n6b.speaker: npc
n6b.en: (the child, petting him) Is he a boy or a girl?

c6c.speaker: client
c6c.en: A boy. His name is Enzo.

n7c.speaker: npc
n7c.en: (the woman, still far off) Pardon? I can't hear a thing!

c7c.speaker: client
c7c.en: (louder) Can you call him back, please?

c7d.speaker: client
c7d.sl: Ali ga lahko daste na povodec?
c7d.en: (louder) Can you put him on the lead?

n8c.speaker: npc
n8c.en: (the woman with the leashed dog) Of course. Aren't they friendly?

c8c.speaker: client
c8c.sl: Ta je prijazen, tisti pa je včasih nervozen.
c8c.en: This one's friendly, that one is sometimes nervous.

c8d.speaker: client
c8d.sl: Ta je še mladiček, samo igrati se hoče.
c8d.en: This one's still a puppy, he just wants to play.

n9b.speaker: npc
n9b.sl: Godrnjavček — to je pes, ki godrnja. Vaš malo godrnja na mojo.
n9b.en: 'Godrnjavček' — a dog that grumbles. Yours is grumbling a bit at mine.
n9b.deliverySL: [toplo] Godrnjavček — to je pes, ki godrnja. Vaš malo godrnja na mojo.

n12b.speaker: npc
n12b.sl: Lepa sta. A lahko temu lepotcu dam malo sendviča?
n12b.en: They're lovely. Can I give this handsome one a bit of my sandwich?
n12b.deliverySL: [toplo] Lepa sta. A lahko temu lepotcu dam malo sendviča?
